source.title: Beach Bot
source.description: Lying on the shore, half-lost in the afternoon spray, is a strange metal contraption. It looks like some kind of mech, but you have never seen anything like it before. You notice a label on its side that reads "Property of D.E.L.T.A.: Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance". You also spot a small compartment that you might be able to open.
source.objective: Use a rock or something to dislodge parts of the mech.
source.completion: Using your weapon and field skills you pry the compartment free, revealing a vial of glowing liquid within.
